offering_description.value: Owns and operates Spanish-language radio stations in major US Hispanic markets such as New York, Los Angeles, Miami, Chicago and Puerto Rico. Sells advertising airtime to businesses and runs digital, streaming and live event offerings that reach Hispanic audiences.

primary_services.value: radio broadcasting; advertising airtime; digital and streaming media; live entertainment events

customer_segment.value: B2B: national and local advertisers and advertising agencies targeting Hispanic audiences

end_markets.value: advertising; media and entertainment; Hispanic consumer marketing

revenue_model.value: advertising: on-air spots, digital advertising and sponsorships sold to advertisers; other: event ticketing and sponsorship revenue from live concerts and promotions

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates FM radio stations and licenses, broadcasting content to listeners and selling airtime to advertisers

geography_served.value: US regional: Major Hispanic markets including New York, Los Angeles, Miami, Chicago, San Francisco and Puerto Rico

specialization.value: related lines: Spanish-language radio, digital streaming and live events aimed at Hispanic audiences

distribution_channels.value: own locations: over-the-air radio stations owned and operated; online: streaming, websites and mobile apps; direct sales: in-house sales staff selling airtime to advertisers and agencies

regulatory_exposure.value: high: broadcast licenses and ownership rules regulated by the FCC

notes: Station market list may have changed; current station holdings are uncertain.
